addressed the weeping Sumantra, saying : " 0 Sumantra, 
prepare four divisions of the army laden with wealth to 
accompany Shri Rama. Let beautitill and eloquent women

chosen citizens accompany Rama with instruments of war and 
vehicles, and those who know the fotest paths, go also. Sbri 
Rama hunting the deer and elephants, drinking fresh honey 
and enjoying the beaury of the rivers will call those left behind

Rams to the uninbabited forest. Observing sacrifices with the 
sages in sacred places, bestowing alms upon them, Shri Rama

here and Rama set out abundantly provided." 
Ksikeyi was seized with fear on hearing the words of the king, 
her mouth dried up and she was unable to speak. Trembling 
with agitation, she then said : " 0 Chief of men, Bbarata will 
not accept the kingdom stripped of its wealth and people,
